May 21, 2018 - By Jonathan Benavides
Glenn J. Krevlin decreased its stake in Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Co (HMHC) by 29.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Glenhill Advisors Llc sold 349,578 shares as the company’s stock declined 24.19% with the market. The hedge fund run by Glenn J. Krevlin held 820,412 shares of the books company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.63 million, down from 1.17M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Glenhill Advisors Llc who had been investing in Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Co for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $832.93M market cap company. The stock decreased 0.74% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $6.75. About 536,954 shares traded. Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Company (NASDAQ:HMHC) has declined 25.40% since May 21, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.95% the S&P500.
Denver Investment Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.95% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Denver Investment Advisors Llc sold 2,215 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 231,595 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $39.19 million, down from 233,810 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Denver Investment Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $915.74 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.36% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $186.31. About 16.17M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 21, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (Put) (IWM) by 170,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.35M shares, and has risen its stake in Beacon Roofing Supply Inc (NASDAQ:BECN).
